final_message:
I fixed `int_to_roman` in `src/roman.py`. I haven't run it or any tests.

The function only had the symbols M, D, C, L, X, V and I. It never produced the subtractive forms, so 4 came out as `IIII` instead of `IV`, and 9, 40, 90, 400 and 900 were wrong in the same way. I added the pairs `CM`, `CD`, `XC`, `XL`, `IX` and `IV` to the lookup table. The greedy loop is unchanged.

`roman_to_int` already handles subtractive notation, so it needed no change.
